steps.name: Data notice
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap the Agree and continue button at the bottom. Otherwise only wait for the session list in the left rail.
steps.done: The data notice is gone and the session list shows in the left rail.

steps.name: Updates pill on the rail
steps.goal: If the round plus labelled Chats without a project is selected, tap the api-gateway folder pill in the left rail. Otherwise only wait. Do not tap any element labelled add.
steps.done: The rail lists the api-gateway sessions and the updates pill shows at the foot of the rail.
expect: Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window

steps.name: Rail menu opens inside the rail
steps.goal: Tap the Navigation button at the top left of the rail (labelled Navigation. Computer: ...). Do not tap anything else.
steps.done: The rail shows a Back button and the navigation rows (Chat, Artifacts, Archive, Notifications, Schedules, Settings) in place of the session list. The composer pane on the right is still visible.

steps.name: Back to the list
steps.goal: Tap the button labelled exactly Back, at the top left of the rail. It is the only way out of this menu.
steps.done: The rail shows its list again and the navigation rows are gone.

steps.name: Updates open in the rail
steps.goal: Tap the updates pill at the foot of the rail (labelled ... updates from auto agents. Open).
steps.done: An Updates list is open at the foot of the rail, under the sessions, with a Hide updates control. It is not a bottom sheet.

steps.name: Updates fold back
steps.done: The Updates list is gone and the updates pill is back at the foot of the rail.

steps.name: Collapse the rail
steps.goal: Tap the Collapse sidebar handle on the rail's divider.
steps.done: The rail is gone, the composer pane fills the screen, and an Expand sidebar handle sits at the left edge.

steps.name: Expand the rail
steps.goal: Tap the Expand sidebar handle at the left edge.
steps.done: The rail and its list are back.
